category: embedding inference tied to a vector database cluster, daily request cap on a free cluster

free_tier.stated: usable on a free Weaviate Cloud cluster at 2,000 embedding requests per cluster per day; with 200 objects per batch that is at most 400,000 embeddings a day. Text models: snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v1.5 and -l-v2.0; multimodal: ModernVBERT/colmodernvbert; no reranker is listed
free_tier.notes: the service is called from a cluster, with no separate key: 'you only need a connection to your Weaviate Cloud cluster'

tooling: Weaviate client libraries vectorize on import and query; the service is enabled by default for every cluster
chaining: embeddings stay inside the same free cluster that stores the vectors

limits.value: 2,000 requests per cluster per day on a free cluster; batch import is capped at 200 objects per batch, so at most 400,000 embeddings per day

identity_cost.detail: a Weaviate Cloud account and a free cluster; unverified: the sign-up form fields and whether a card is asked, because the console answered with a login wall to the page reader

reliability_note: the page calls Weaviate Embeddings a paid service that can be tried free on a free cluster; the data is processed in the United States
confidence_note: the daily request cap, the batch size and the model list are quoted from the vendor page; the sign-up fields are unverified.

evidence.quote: Weaviate Embeddings only imposes usage limits on requests for free clusters. The rate limit for free clusters is `2000` requests per cluster per day.
evidence.proved: a free cluster is limited to 2,000 embedding requests per cluster per day

evidence.quote: This means that you can generate up to a maximum of `400 000` embeddings (`2000 (requests) * 200 (objects per request)`) within your free cluster.
evidence.proved: a free cluster can generate at most 400,000 embeddings a day with 200 objects per batch

evidence.quote: > You can try it out for free on a free cluster.
evidence.proved: Weaviate Embeddings can be tried free on a free cluster
snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0 is one of the hosted text embedding models

binding_note: 2,000 requests per cluster per day is the only published limit on a free cluster
notes: derived: 2,000 requests * 200 objects per batch = 400,000 embeddings per day, as the vendor page states
